news.title: NVIDIA Kumo Forecast 结合预训练与历史模式检索
news.body: 模型结合时间序列表征和可选历史检索，并提供分预测时域的解释接口。检索上下文与近期输入窗口不同，实际收益和解释可靠性仍需按数据与任务验证。
news.title_original: NVIDIA Kumo Forecast Combines Pretrained Time-Series Representations with Historical Pattern Retrieval and Interpretability

news.title: OpenAI 宣布模型与 Codex 工作流将接入 Google Cloud
news.body: 合作计划通过 Model Garden 与 Marketplace 提供访问，并结合云端治理能力。公告称全面可用预计在未来数周，不能写成所有用户今天已可使用。
news.title_original: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
news.body_original: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

news.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
news.body: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address critical vulnerabilities across open source.

news.title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
news.body: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

news.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
news.body: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

news.title: FairStress 检验模型决策受挑战时的公平性
news.body: Ai2 的基准不仅检查人口属性交换后的初始选择，还测试说服性挑战是否让模型对不同群体表现出不同的改判倾向。结果衡量特定评测中的行为，不能概括所有真实决策的公平性。
news.title_original: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making

news.title: ALTK-Evolve 用经验规则改善客服智能体基准表现
news.body: 方法从训练任务的成功与失败中提取简短规则，加入提示而不更新模型权重。报告结果限定于指定版本的客服基准与榜单快照，不能当作所有生产客服任务的领先表现。
news.title_original: ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model

news.title: 餐饮加盟商分享用 ChatGPT Work 加快对账与定价分析
news.body: 客户案例介绍菜单分析、薪资和现金对账等工作流。节时数字来自经营者自报，潜在现金流改善是估计，不能写成已经实现的利润。
news.title_original: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
news.body_original: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.

news.title: Terminal X 分享投资研究输出的评估与审计工作流
news.body: 案例介绍按机构标准给智能体输出评分，并比较与资深审核人员的判断一致性。企业自报的一致率不代表投资收益或预测市场的准确率，最终决策仍需专业核验。
news.title_original: Terminal X matches senior investor judgment 88.6% with GPT-6.1
news.body_original: Terminal X’s Eval Agent grades outputs against a 54-criterion rubric, catching 25% more deviances from a fund’s mandate with GPT-6.1 Sol.

news.title: OpenAI 宣布收购 Orchestra Bio
news.body: 公告称已收购药物开发协调平台，并计划与 Rosalind 的模型和科研工具结合。后续目标是帮助团队连接研究、实验与项目决策，不代表新疗法已获临床或监管验证。
news.body_original: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.

news.title: TorchTPU 将 TPU 接入原生 PyTorch 工作流
news.body: Hugging Face 介绍原生设备后端、内核与分布式支持，减少以往依赖专门适配层的复杂性。兼容范围、性能与成本仍取决于版本、模型和云硬件。

papers.body: arXiv:2610.28529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Berry-curvature dipole can produce a nonlinear Hall current even when the linear Hall response vanishes, but symmetry alone does not determine its magnitude or magnetic tunability. The interplay of structural symmetry, moment orientation, and carrier occupation is examined in a honeycomb model. Curvature maps and the band-summed dipole integrand reveal how velocity and the occupation window near the Fermi level select signed contributions. Removing threefold rotation permits a nonmagnetic dipole perpendicular to the surviving mirror. papers.body: arXiv:2610.27762v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep generative modeling has achieved remarkable progress in crystal generation. Given the rich symmetries inherent in crystalline structures, recent work has sought to explicitly incorporate space-group symmetry into generative models, enabling more effective exploration of novel symmetry templates. Yet introducing symmetry templates increases the combinatorial complexity of stoichiometric relationships between atomic species and crystallographic sites, while creating a fundamental tension between flexible exploration of discrete crystallographic templates and faithful realization of these templates as continuous three-dimensional structures

papers.body: arXiv:2606.20497v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Navigating the vast space of synthetically accessible molecules demands surrogate models that are interpretable and capable of handling multiple competing objectives at the same time. Here, we introduce a modular pipeline that combines interpretable linear meta-learning models and adaptive-confidence uncertainty quantification into an Efficient Global Optimization (EGO) framework for multi-objective molecular discovery.
